title: ClusterHistoryPoint
description: Hop dong giua clustering (Nam, ben ghi) va query-api / UI xu huong (Nghia, ben doc). Khac voi cluster-record.schema.json (ban ghi 'hien tai' cua mot cum, upsert theo cluster_id): moi lan pipeline tinh diem bat thuong cho mot cum (moi chu ky WINDOW_SECONDS), THEM MOI (khong upsert) mot ClusterHistoryPoint - dung de ve bieu do xu huong score theo thoi gian. Khong doi/dung lai cluster-record.schema.json.

cluster_id.description: Phai khop voi ClusterRecord.cluster_id tuong ung (xem cluster-record.schema.json)

score.description: Anomaly score tai chu ky nay - cung cong thuc voi ClusterRecord.score

status.description: Trang thai cum tai chu ky nay (xem cluster-record.schema.json muc status)

recorded_at.description: window_to cua chu ky clustering luc tinh diem nay - dung lam truc thoi gian khi ve bieu do
